blocks.text: Salmon River homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Salmon River, September 2026. Detached houses: 22 listed at month end and 5 sold in September, a sales ratio of 23% (a sellers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 4 listed at month end and 0 sold in September, a sales ratio of —.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, detached houses sold 17 over 4 months against an average of 23.2 listed, about 5.5 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 7 sold. condos and townhomes sold 1 over 4 months against an average of 3.5 listed, about 14.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 1 sold.
